'''AV-9R''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] AV-9R was on the [[Carrick Station]], where he suffered a mobility malfunction. While being repaired by technician [[Mua Niab]], AV-9R relayed to an important figure a coded priority message from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] regarding the [[Battle of Denova]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
AV-9R appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Operation courier for the "Explosive Conflict" operation. Originally present on the Carrick Station, he was moved to [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] with Update 4.0.
